name: PT Metro Healthcare Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Metro Healthcare Indonesia Tbk owns, operates, and manages hospitals in Indonesia. It provides healthcare activities and physical treatment, outpatient, inpatient managed by private hospitals; manages business consulting and activities, sells laboratory equipment, pharmaceuticals, and medical devices; undertakes hospital activities, and retail trade of pharmaceutical products at pharmacies. It also offers management consulting services; and operates private polyclinics. The company was founded in 2015 and is based in Tangerang, Indonesia.
